title: [test] VERIFY: build, lint, and full test suite green
description: Final verification gate. Run npm run build (tsc emits dist/cli.js), npm run lint (eslint src/ tests/ clean, no any types, no console.log in src/api/*), and npm test (full Jest suite including all new CLI tests) -- all must pass. Fix or file follow-ups for any failure surfaced. This task runs after every impl and test task. Files: none new (verification only).
acceptance_criteria: npm run build, npm run lint, and npm test all exit 0 with the full suite (existing API tests + new CLI CRUD/help/validation/version tests) passing and no lint errors; dist/cli.js is emitted by the build.

title: [impl] Implement five CRUD subcommands (list/read/create/update/delete)
description: In src/cli.ts, implement the five subcommands using the shared client and the validation helper: list [--tag <tag>] [--q <query>] -> GET /api/notes; read --id <id> -> GET /api/notes/:id; create --title <t> --content <c> -> POST; update --id <id> [--title][--content] -> PUT; delete --id <id> -> DELETE. Print results to stdout. Any API error (network or 4xx/5xx) exits non-zero surfacing the body's error/errors field, never a raw stack trace. Validate required args before the HTTP call. Files: src/cli.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Running each of list/read/create/update/delete against the running server hits the matching /api/notes endpoint and prints results to stdout; missing/blank required args fail validation before any HTTP call; API/network errors exit non-zero with the surfaced error/errors message and no stack trace; npx tsc --noEmit passes.

title: [impl] CLI entry point: arg parsing + subcommand dispatch + bin wiring
description: Create src/cli.ts as the single entry point: parse argv, dispatch to subcommands (list/read/create/update/delete stubs are fine here -- filled in by the CRUD task), and route unknown commands to an error on stderr with non-zero exit. Wire a bin entry in package.json pointing at dist/cli.js and ensure build compiles it. Import the shared client from src/cli/client.ts. No console.log in src/api/*. Files: src/cli.ts (new), package.json (bin field).
acceptance_criteria: src/cli.ts exists, parses argv and dispatches by first positional subcommand, imports the src/cli/client.ts foundation, and errors non-zero on unknown commands without a stack trace; package.json has a bin entry mapping the CLI to dist/cli.js and npm run build emits dist/cli.js; npx tsc --noEmit passes.

title: [impl] Shared HTTP-client module for CLI (NOTEAPI_URL base URL)
description: Create src/cli/client.ts: a single HTTP client the whole CLI reuses (not an in-process call into noteStore). Base URL from NOTEAPI_URL env var, default http://localhost:3000. Expose typed helpers get/post/put/del that call /api/notes endpoints, parse JSON, and define the CLI's own response interfaces (mirror Note fields; do NOT import src/models or src/utils across the process boundary). On network failure or 4xx/5xx, surface the response body's error or errors field as a clean message (never a raw stack trace) so callers can exit non-zero. Files: src/cli/client.ts (new).
acceptance_criteria: src/cli/client.ts exists exporting a reusable client with get/post/put/del bound to a base URL read from NOTEAPI_URL (default http://localhost:3000); it defines CLI-local response types and imports nothing from src/models or src/utils; on non-2xx or network error it produces a clean message derived from the body's error/errors field with no stack trace; project still compiles (npx tsc --noEmit).
